                                              (omega : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts)

                                                  RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.hasDirection cuts D g d
                                                      (RiffleUpperV2.sortedWord omega
                                                        (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pilePosition cuts p d j)) →
                                                    ∀ (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k (L + 1)),
                                                      0 < ↑x.fst →
                                                        (∀ (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)),
                                                            RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder x w →

                                                                match d with
                                                                | RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction.forward =>
                                                                  RiffleUpperV2.sortedWord omega
                                                                      (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pilePosition cuts p d
                                                                        j) <

                                                                    RiffleUpperV2.sortedWord omega

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.futureCylinders_depth_pos
type:
∀ {k K : ℕ} (s t : RiffleUpperV2.Word k K) {x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K},
  x ∈ RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.futureCylinders s t → 0 < ↑x.fst

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.wordPrefix._proof_1
type: ∀ {K : ℕ}, ∀ r ≤ K, ¬r < K + 1 → False

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.intermediateCollision_power
type:
∀ {N lam qstar ξ η α tail : ℝ},
  0 < N →
    0 ≤ lam →
      0 ≤ qstar →
        α ≤ 1 / 2 →
          N * lam ≤ N ^ ξ →
            qstar ≤ N ^ (-η + ξ) →
              tail ≤ qstar ^ (1 - 2 * α) →
                N ^ 2 * lam ^ (2 * (1 - α)) * tail ≤ N ^ (-η + 3 * ξ + 2 * α * (1 + η - 2 * ξ))

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.futureCylinders_child._proof_1_1
type: ∀ {k K : ℕ} {x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K}, 0 < ↑x.fst → ¬↑x.fst - 1 < K → False

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.tailColumnCount._proof_1_3
type: ∀ {K r : ℕ}, r ≤ K → ∀ (j : Fin (K - r)), ↑j < K - r → ¬r + ↑j < K → False

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.in_wordPrefix._simp_1
type:
∀ {k K : ℕ} (w v : RiffleUpperV2.Word k K) (r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ K),
  RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder (RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.wordPrefix w r hr) v =
    (List.take r (List.Vector.toList w) <+: List.Vector.toList v)

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.intermediate_maximalTail_le
type:
∀ {k n K N : ℕ},
  2 ≤ N →
    ∀ (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n K) (hn : 0 < n) (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K) {η ξ : ℝ},
      ↑N ^ (-ξ) ≤ RiffleUpperV2.prefixMean cuts x →
        RiffleUpperV2.empiricalBeta N 0 cuts hn K ≤ -η →
          RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.maximalTailMass cuts hn x ≤ ↑N ^ (-η + ξ)

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.maximalTailMass_pos
type:
∀ {k n K : ℕ} (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n K) (hn : 0 < n) (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K),
  0 < RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.maximalTailMass cuts hn x

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.futureCylinders_disjoint
type:
∀ {k K : ℕ} (s t : RiffleUpperV2.Word k K) {x y : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K},
  x ∈ RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.futureCylinders s t →
    y ∈ RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.futureCylinders s t →
      ∀ {w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k K},
        RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder x w → RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder y w → x = y

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.parentList
type: {k K : ℕ} → RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K → List (Fin k)

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.decayBudget._proof_1
type: (2 + 1).AtLeastTwo

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder_tailBinPrefix
type:
∀ {k L : ℕ} (E : ℕ) (p : Fin k) (v : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (min E L)) (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)),
  RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.tailBinPrefix E p v) w ↔
    List.Vector.get w 0 = p ∧ RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.tailPrefix E w = v

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.tailBinPrefix_of_first._proof_1_1
type:
∀ {k L : ℕ} (p : Fin k) (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k (L + 1)),
  0 < ↑x.fst → ∀ (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)), ¬min (↑x.fst - 1) L + 1 = ↑x.fst → False

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.tailColumnCount._proof_1_2
type: ∀ {K r : ℕ}, r ≤ K → ∀ ⦃i j : { j : Fin K // ¬↑j < r }⦄, ↑↑i - r = ↑↑j - r → ¬↑↑i = ↑↑j → False

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.tinyCylinder_count._proof_1_2
type: ∀ (k D Nf Nb : ℕ), 1 ≤ Nb → ∀ (n : ℕ), Nf + Nb + 2 ≤ n → ∀ (L : ℕ) (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k (L + 1)), ¬Nf ≤ n → False

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.tinyCylinder_count._proof_1_1
type: ∀ (k D Nf : ℕ), 1 ≤ Nf → ∀ (Nb : ℕ), 1 ≤ Nb → ¬2 ≤ Nf + Nb + 2 → False

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.futureCylinders
type: {k K : ℕ} → RiffleUpperV2.Word k K → RiffleUpperV2.Word k K → Finset (RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K)

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.maximalTailMass_lower._simp_1_1
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder α] {a b : α}, (¬a < b) = (b ≤ a)

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.lateShortMean_le._proof_1_2
type: ∀ {k : ℕ} {n : ℕ} {K N : ℕ}, 2 ≤ N → ∀ (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K) {ρ : ℝ}, ¬1 ≤ N → False

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.tailBinPrefix_of_cylinder
type:
∀ {k L : ℕ} (p : Fin k) (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k (L + 1)),
  0 < ↑x.fst →
    (∀ (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)), RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder x w → List.Vector.get w 0 = p) →
      ∃ (E : ℕ) (v : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (min E L)), RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.tailBinPrefix E p v = x

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.endpointChild._proof_1
type: ∀ {K : ℕ} (j : Fin K), ¬↑j + 1 < K + 1 → False

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.prefixFirst_of_cylinder
type:
∀ {k L : ℕ} (p : Fin k) (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k (L + 1)) (hx : 0 < ↑x.fst),
  (∀ (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)), RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder x w → List.Vector.get w 0 = p) →
    List.Vector.get x.snd ⟨0, hx⟩ = p

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.futureCylinders_disjoint._proof_1_1
type: ∀ {k K : ℕ} {a b : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K}, ¬↑a.fst = ↑b.fst → ↑a.fst ≤ ↑b.fst → ¬↑a.fst < ↑b.fst → False

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.futureCylinders_card
type: ∀ {k K : ℕ} (s t : RiffleUpperV2.Word k K), (RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.futureCylinders s t).card ≤ 2 * k * K

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.tinyCylinder_count.match_1
type:
(motive : RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction → Sort u_1) →
  (d : RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction) →
    (Unit → motive RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction.forward) →
      (Unit → motive RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction.backward) → motive d

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder
type: {k K : ℕ} → RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K → RiffleUpperV2.Word k K → Prop
